meta.title: Prosper Pro Tutorial
meta.description: Complete guide to every view and feature in Prosper Pro.

hero.title: Prosper Pro Tutorial
hero.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of every view and feature in your financial dashboard.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: The Dashboard is your financial control center. Here you see a consolidated overview of your financial situation at a glance.

features.name: Summary pills
features.desc: Show Savings in Plans, Recurring Payments/Month and Completed Goals/Plans. Tap one to navigate to the related section.

features.name: My Accounts widget
features.desc: View up to 3 favorite accounts. You can hide/show balances and mark/unmark favorites from Finances.

features.name: Currency Converter
features.desc: Convert between USD, EUR, BS and cryptocurrencies in Official or P2P mode.

features.name: Financial chart
features.desc: Analyze income, expenses and savings by period (day, week, month or year).

features.name: Quick actions
features.desc: Shortcuts to create a plan, record a transaction, open the calendar or add an account.

features.name: Customization
features.desc: Use the floating 'Customize' button to add, remove, reorder and resize widgets.

finances.title: Finances
finances.intro: The Finances section groups all your accounts, transactions and accounting tools.

features.name: Accounts
features.desc: Create accounts in USD, BS, EUR or crypto. Edit name, type, currency and color. Mark favorites so they appear on the Dashboard.

features.name: Transactions
features.desc: Record income, expenses, transfers and plan contributions. Every movement updates the account balance automatically.

features.name: Filters and search
features.desc: Filter by type, category, account, currency or date range. Use the search box to find movements by description.

features.name: Finances chart
features.desc: Review income, expenses and savings in a bar chart with different periods.

features.name: VEPay
features.desc: Capture payment receipts to extract data automatically and record transactions faster.

features.name: Accounting management
features.desc: Recalculate balances, delete history by type or account, and reset balances when you need to reorganize your data.

features.name: Transfers between accounts
features.desc: Move money between accounts; if currencies differ, it converts automatically using the official rate.

plans.title: Financial Plans
plans.intro: Formerly called Goals, this view lets you plan savings, planned expenses and recurring payments.

features.name: Plan types
features.desc: Create Savings, Planned Expense or Recurring plans. Each has its own flow and metrics.

features.name: Custom categories
features.desc: Choose a predefined category or create your own to better organize your plans.

features.name: Contributions and payments
features.desc: Add funds to savings plans, record recurring payments and contribute to planned expenses.

features.name: Sub-plans
features.desc: Split a large plan into smaller stages or concepts and contribute to each one separately.

features.name: Shared plans
features.desc: Invite other users by email to split an expense and track who contributed.

features.name: Requests
features.desc: Accept or reject invitations to shared plans you have received.

features.name: Filters and status
features.desc: Filter by type, status (pending, in progress, completed, cancelled) and search by name.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: The Calendar unifies your plans, reminders and transactions in a visual timeline.

features.name: Monthly view
features.desc: Navigate months and see days with activity through color indicators.

features.name: Reminders
features.desc: Create reminders with title, description, time and type. Enable recurrence for periodic reminders.

features.name: Financial events
features.desc: Plans with deadlines and upcoming recurring payments appear automatically.

features.name: Side panel
features.desc: When you select a day, review the details of scheduled reminders and events.

features.name: Custom types
features.desc: Define your own reminder types to adapt the calendar to your needs.

courses.title: Courses
courses.intro: The Prosper Academy offers financial education courses to improve your money decisions.

features.name: Course catalog
features.desc: Browse available courses with description, duration and level.

features.name: Modules and lessons
features.desc: Each course is divided into modules. Complete lessons to progress.

features.name: Progress
features.desc: Your progress is saved automatically and you can resume where you left off.

features.name: Enrollment
features.desc: Enroll in courses that interest you and earn rewards upon completion.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Customize your profile, global preferences and security from one place.

features.name: Profile
features.desc: Edit your name, photo, bio and base currency.

features.name: Language and theme
features.desc: Switch between Spanish and English, and select Light, Dark or AMOLED theme.

features.name: Currency and rates
features.desc: Set your display currency and choose between Official BCV rate or P2P for cryptocurrencies.

features.name: Notifications
features.desc: Enable rate alerts, daily balance summary and browser/device push notifications.

features.name: Dashboard
features.desc: Customize widgets, categories and the desktop and mobile layouts separately.

features.name: Security
features.desc: Change your password, review active sessions, wipe your data or delete your account.

help.title: Help
help.intro: The Help Center answers frequently asked questions and lets you contact support.

features.name: FAQ
features.desc: Search answers by category or keyword.

features.name: Quick links
features.desc: Quickly navigate to the most common actions like creating a plan or recording a transaction.

features.name: Support chat
features.desc: Send bug reports or suggestions. History is saved so you can follow the conversation.

features.name: Release notes
features.desc: Check the news and improvements of each update.
